---
title: Div syntax for definition lists
format:
  html: default
  latex: default
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - "div#tight > dl > dt > code"
          - "div#loose > dl > dd > p"
          - "div#nested > dl > dd > dl > dt"
          - "div#list-table-in-definition > dl > dd > table"
          - "div#not-a-list.definition-list > p"
          - "div#no-definitions.definition-list > ul"
        - - "div#tight div.definition-list"
          - "div#loose div.definition-list"
          - "div#nested div.definition-list"
          - "div#list-table-in-definition div.list-table"
    latex:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - - '\\begin\{description\}'
          - '\\item\[\\texttt\{time\}\]'
          - '\\item\[Outer term\]'
          - '\\item\[Table term\][\s\S]*?\\begin\{longtable\}'
        - []
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - - '/ Loose term: #block\['
          - '/ Inner term: #block\['
          - '/ Table term: #block\[\s*#table\('
        - []
---

The `.definition-list` div is the definition list syntax of Quarto 2.
Each item of the outer bullet list is a term, and each item of its
nested bullet list is one of that term's definitions.

The `id`s below are only for the tests. A `DefinitionList` has no
attributes, so the div's `id` is dropped, and the tests locate each list
by the wrapper div added around it.

::: {#tight}
::: {.definition-list}
* `time`
  - A timestamp that identifies when the request was initiated.
  - Type: string
* `id`
  - A unique identifier.
:::
:::

::: {#loose}
::: {.definition-list}
* Loose term

  - A definition with two paragraphs.

    The second paragraph.

  - Another definition.
:::
:::

::: {#nested}
::: {.definition-list}
* Outer term
  - ::: {.definition-list}
    * Inner term
      - Inner definition.
    :::
:::
:::

::: {#list-table-in-definition}
::: {.definition-list}
* Table term
  - ::: {.list-table}
    * - Fruit
      - Price
    * - Apple
      - 1.20
    :::
:::
:::

A div that doesn't have the definition-list shape is left as is.

::: {#not-a-list .definition-list}
Not a list.
:::

::: {#no-definitions .definition-list}
* A term without a nested list of definitions.
:::
